Title: Ishaan's Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Riya - 8 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
3. Sonali - 37 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Riya stands in the living room. Sonali stands near her.]

Riya: "Mom, what's the plan today?"

[Riya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Riya: "I'm ready!"

[Riya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Riya: "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Riya and Sonali stand near him.]

Riya: "Mom, look over here."

[Ishaan searches for his lost ball.]

Ishaan: "Careful!"

[Ishaan dances to the music.]

Ishaan (surprised): "What happened?"

[Ishaan takes the bag from Mother.]

Riya (gently): "I knew it!"

[Ishaan carries his school bag on his back.]

Sonali: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Riya draws a rangoli at the door.]

Riya: "Mom, listen!"

[Ishaan hurts his knee.]

Ishaan: "I knew it!"

[A hailstorm begins.]

Ishaan: "That was such a fun day!"
